cards.name: Duelist
cards.text: Footwork: once per turn, after you hit with a melee attack, move 5 ft × ½ DEX. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks. Riposte (½ STR/S.R.): reaction, when a melee attack misses you: make one melee weapon attack against the attacker.
cards.lore: Footwork drilled until it needs no thought. The blade goes where the eyes already are.

cards.name: Templar
cards.text: Oath (½ WIL/S.R.): reaction, when an attack hits an ally within 5 ft: you take its damage instead, reduced by 2 × STR.
cards.lore: A vow, a shield arm and a spine that does not bend. Others stand behind this one.

cards.name: Spellblade
cards.text: Battle Caster: a weapon you hold counts as an empty Hand for casting from a Spellbook. Spell Strike (½ STR/S.R.): when you hit with a melee weapon attack: +INT damage.
cards.lore: Steel in one hand, a spell on the tongue. Taught that the two were never separate.

cards.name: Infiltrator
cards.text: Unseen: your checks to sneak, pick locks and spot traps add both DEX and INT.
cards.lore: Locks, ledges and the patience of a held breath. Nobody remembers seeing them leave.

cards.name: Performer
cards.text: Crowd Work (½ DEX/S.R.): reaction, after an ally within 30 ft rolls an attack or a check: +WIL to that roll.
cards.lore: Quick feet and a quicker smile. Every room is a stage, every fight an audience.

cards.name: Sage
cards.text: Learned: ½ INT extra spell points. Your checks to recall lore add both INT and WIL.
cards.lore: A mind that kept every page it ever read, and a voice that makes the pages speak.

cards.name: Brawler
cards.text: Scrapper: +STR to hit with Grapples and Shoves. Slip Free: your Escape attacks add 2 × DEX instead of STR or DEX.
cards.lore: Taverns, docks and pit fights. Swords are for people who can't hold on.

cards.name: Zealot
cards.text: Righteous Fury (½ WIL/S.R.): when you hit with a weapon attack: +½ STR d6 Radiant damage.
cards.lore: A fire that won't go out, and a cause worth burning for. Doubt is for other people.

cards.name: Tactician
cards.text: Command (½ STR/S.R.): action. An ally within 30 ft who can hear you takes the Attack action at once, with +INT to hit.
cards.lore: Every fight is a board, every ally a piece. They see the move three turns before it lands.

cards.name: Ranger
cards.text: Quarry (½ INT/S.R.): when you hit a creature with a ranged attack, it's marked: you and your allies have +½ DEX on attacks against it until the start of your next turn.
cards.lore: Weeks alone on a trail, and an arrow that never wastes its flight.

cards.name: Trickster
cards.text: Feint (½ WIL/S.R.): reaction, when an attack hits you: −DEX to that attack roll, possibly turning it into a miss.
cards.lore: Never where you swing. Always where you look away. The grin is the last thing you see.

cards.name: Hermit
cards.text: Solitude: ½ WIL extra Resolve. Your checks to forage and endure add both INT and WIL.
cards.lore: Years in a cave or a forest, talking to stones and stars. Something out there answered.

cards.name: Leather
cards.lore: Supple hide, oiled and stitched. It creaks a little, but it lets you run.

cards.name: Mail
cards.lore: Riveted rings over a padded coat. Heavy on the shoulders, light on the conscience.

cards.name: Plate
cards.lore: Full steel, fitted to you. You hear yourself coming, and so does everyone else.

cards.name: Shield
cards.text: Takes one Hand.
cards.lore: Oak boards, an iron rim, a dented boss. Every scar on it is a blow you never felt.

cards.name: Dagger
cards.text: +2 to hit, thrown 20/60 ft, 1d4 + DEX Physical.
cards.lore: Every traveler carries one. It cuts bread, rope and, when it must, throats.

cards.name: Shortsword
cards.text: +2 to hit, 1d6 + STR or DEX Physical.
cards.lore: A short, honest blade for tight alleys and crowded fights.

cards.name: Handaxe
cards.text: +2 to hit, thrown 20/60 ft, 1d6 + STR or DEX Physical.
cards.lore: A woodcutter's tool that learned a second trade. It flies true when thrown.

cards.name: Finesse Blade
cards.text: +2 to hit, 1d6 + DEX Physical. Sap: when you hit, the target has −2 on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn.
cards.lore: A slim duelist's sword. A nick here, a cut there, and the foe's arm grows slow.

cards.name: Longsword
cards.text: +2 to hit, 1d8 / 1d10 + STR Physical.
cards.lore: The knight's blade: one hand for the shield, two hands when the shield breaks.

cards.name: Battleaxe
cards.text: +2 to hit, 1d8 / 1d10 + STR or DEX Physical.
cards.lore: A bearded head on an ash haft. It splits shields as easily as firewood.

cards.name: Greatsword
cards.text: +2 to hit, 2d6 + STR Physical.
cards.lore: As tall as a child and twice as loud. You don't parry it; you get out of its way.

cards.name: Glaive
cards.text: +2 to hit, 1d10 + STR Physical.
cards.lore: A blade on a long pole. It keeps the enemy at a distance, where it should be.

cards.name: Longbow
cards.text: +2 to hit, range 150/600 ft, 1d8 + DEX Physical.
cards.lore: Yew, horn and patience. A trained archer drops a charging boar before it closes.

cards.name: Sling
cards.text: +2 to hit, range 30/120 ft, 1d6 + DEX Physical.
cards.lore: A strip of leather and a pouch of stones. Shepherds have killed giants with less.

cards.name: Javelins
cards.text: +2 to hit, thrown 30/120 ft, 1d6 + STR or DEX Physical.
cards.lore: A bundle of light spears, made to be thrown first and asked about later.

cards.name: Spellguard Staff
cards.text: +2 to hit, 1d6 / 1d8 + INT or WIL Physical. While you hold it, it counts as an empty Hand for casting from a Spellbook.
cards.lore: Runes run along its grain. The wood remembers the shape of a casting hand.

cards.name: Traveler's Lute
cards.text: 1 extra Resolve (short rest). Your Anthems reach 60 ft instead of 30 ft.
cards.lore: Its varnish is worn where a hundred hands have strummed it. The tunes carry far.

cards.name: Greatclub
cards.text: +2 to hit, 1d10 + STR Physical.
cards.lore: A tree limb with ambitions. What it hits stays down for a while.

cards.name: Gladius
cards.text: +2 to hit, 1d6 + STR or DEX Physical. Close Order: +1d4 damage while an ally is engaged with the same creature.
cards.lore: A soldier's sword, short and wide, made for fighting shoulder to shoulder.

cards.name: Boarspear
cards.text: +3 to hit, 1d8 / 1d10 + STR Physical. Brace: your opportunity attacks with it deal +1d8 damage.
cards.lore: Its crossbar stops a charging beast on the point. Hunters set it, then wait.

cards.name: Pilum
cards.text: +3 to hit, thrown 30/120 ft, 1d6 + STR or DEX Physical. Pierce: on a hit, a Shield the target holds gives no bonus until it spends an action to pull the pilum free.
cards.lore: A soft iron shank bends on impact, so the spear can't be thrown back, and the shield can't be raised.

cards.name: Shortbow
cards.text: +2 to hit, range 80/320 ft, 1d6 + DEX Physical.
cards.lore: Light enough to shoot from the saddle or from the treetops.

cards.name: Greataxe
cards.text: +2 to hit, 1d12 + STR Physical.
cards.lore: A crescent of iron on a heavy haft. One swing, one problem fewer.

cards.name: Fine Bow
cards.text: +2 to hit, range 150/600 ft, 1d10 + DEX Physical.
cards.lore: Horn, sinew and years of an archer's patience. Only steady fingers can draw it.

cards.name: Wand
cards.text: +2 to hit, range 60/120 ft, 1d8 + INT Lightning.
cards.lore: A rod of black wood capped with copper. It hums in a thinking hand and crackles when pointed.

cards.name: Ring of Warding
cards.text: Reaction (2/S.R.), when an attack hits you: +2 to the targeted Defense against that attack, possibly turning it into a miss.
cards.lore: A band of cold silver. It tightens around the finger just before the blow lands.

cards.name: Guild Signet
cards.text: Action (1/L.R.), in a settlement where the guild operates: a contact finds you within 1 hour. They share one fact the guild would know, or hide you for a night.
cards.lore: Press it into wax and doors open. Lose it, and someone comes asking why.

cards.name: Shard Bandolier
cards.text: You can carry 2 more Shards in your Pack (5 in all). They still count toward its 8 pieces.
cards.lore: Leather straps padded for crystal. Shards clink softly against each other as you walk.

cards.name: Holy Amulet
cards.text: 1 extra Resolve (short rest). Your Cues reach 90 ft instead of 60 ft.
cards.lore: A blessed token on a worn cord. Prayers spoken over it seem to travel further.

cards.name: Boots of the Long Stride
cards.text: Reaction (1/S.R.): Move.
cards.lore: Soft boots that never wear out. Every few steps, one lands farther than it should.

cards.name: Ring of Sparks
cards.text: Reaction (1/S.R.), when a creature within 5 ft hits you: it takes 2d6 Lightning.
cards.lore: Copper wire coiled around a blue stone. It bites whoever lays a hand on its wearer.

cards.name: Dancer's Bells
cards.text: 1 extra Resolve (short rest). Your Dirges reach 90 ft instead of 60 ft.
cards.lore: A string of tiny bells for the ankle. Their jingle gets under an enemy's skin.

cards.name: Potion of Healing
cards.text: Action: drink it, or give it to a creature within 5 ft. It regains 2d4 + 2 HP.
cards.lore: Red and faintly warm, it tastes of iron and cherries. Shake before drinking.

cards.name: Coin Pouch
cards.text: Holds up to 100 gp.
cards.lore: A drawstring purse of good leather. Its weight is the only friend some people have.

cards.name: Writ of Favor
cards.text: A sealed letter from a noble house, a guild or a temple. Show it to one of its members: they grant one reasonable request (shelter, an audience, safe passage, a loan up to 100 gp).
cards.lore: Heavy paper, a heavy seal. A debt someone important promised to repay.

cards.name: Greater Potion of Healing
cards.text: Action: drink it, or give it to a creature within 5 ft. It regains 4d4 + 4 HP.
cards.lore: Deep crimson and almost hot to hold. Wounds close while you're still swallowing.

cards.name: Restorative Salve
cards.text: Action: spread it on a creature within 5 ft. Heal one of its Wounds.
cards.lore: Bitter herbs, river clay and a healer's patience, sealed in a tin.

cards.name: Pocket Sand
cards.text: Reaction: throw it at a creature within 5 ft. Attack (DEX or WIL + 2) against its DEX Defense: on a hit, it has −2 on attacks until the end of its next turn.
cards.lore: The oldest trick there is. It still works.

cards.name: Alchemist's Fire Recipe
cards.text: Reaction: throw a flask up to 30 ft. Make one attack (DEX or INT + 3) against the DEX Defense of each creature within 5 ft of the impact: 2d6 Fire on a hit, half on a miss.
cards.lore: Three corked flasks and the knowledge to fill them. Keep them away from the campfire.

cards.name: Springheel
cards.text: Your jump distances are doubled, and you never need a running start.
cards.lore: It came from someone who never learned to walk, only to bound.

cards.name: Stone Blood
cards.text: +2 STR Defense against poison and disease.
cards.lore: Taken from a taster at a poisoner's court. Nothing in a cup ever hurt them again.

cards.name: Iron Will
cards.text: +2 WIL Defense against fear and mind control.
cards.lore: The resolve of someone who stared down terrors and did not blink.

cards.name: Clear Mind
cards.text: +2 INT Defense against illusions and confusion.
cards.lore: A mind that sees through mist and mirrors. Illusions slide off it like rain.

cards.name: Cleave
cards.text: 1/S.R., when your melee attack drops a creature to 0 HP: make one melee attack against another creature within your reach.
cards.lore: A soldier's reflex: when one foe falls, the blade is already moving to the next.

cards.name: Steady Aim
cards.text: Reaction (2/S.R.): your next ranged attack this turn has +2 to hit.
cards.lore: A hunter's breath, held between heartbeats, until the arrow flies.

cards.name: Shield Bash
cards.text: Reaction (1/S.R.), when you take the Attack action while holding a Shield: Shove a creature within 5 ft.
cards.lore: Shields aren't only for hiding behind. A veteran knows the rim is a weapon too.

cards.name: Battle Hymn
cards.text: 2/S.R., when you hit with a weapon attack: up to 3 allies within 30 ft who can hear you have +2 on their next attack before the end of your next turn.
cards.lore: A warrior's chant that rose with every strike, until the whole line sang along.

cards.name: Rallying Cry
cards.text: Rally as a loose Anthem. Action (1/S.R.): Duration 1 minute. Up to 3 allies within 30 ft have +2 on attacks.
cards.lore: One voice that turns a rout into a charge. It remembers every battlefield it saved.

cards.name: Shield Wall
cards.text: Reaction (1/S.R.), when an attack hits an ally within 5 ft while you hold a Shield: +2 to the targeted Defense against that attack, possibly turning it into a miss.
cards.lore: Learned in the front rank, where your shield guards the friend beside you.

cards.name: Cat Burglar
cards.text: +2 on checks to sneak, climb or pick locks.
cards.lore: The habits of someone who never used a door if a window would do.

cards.name: Renowned
cards.text: +2 on checks to persuade, haggle, gather rumors or perform.
cards.lore: A name that opens doors. Everyone has heard the stories, true or not.

cards.name: Sailor
cards.text: +2 on checks to swim, climb, navigate or gather rumors.
cards.lore: Salt in the blood, knots in the fingers, and a tavern story for every port.

cards.name: Street Urchin
cards.text: +2 on checks to pick pockets, sneak, read intentions or gather rumors.
cards.lore: Taught by gutters and hunger. Nobody sees a child in the crowd until their purse is gone.

cards.name: Hunter
cards.text: +2 on checks to track, notice, sneak or handle animals.
cards.lore: Broken twigs, bent grass, the hush before a deer bolts. The wild speaks; this one listens.

cards.name: Physician
cards.text: +2 on checks to treat wounds, recall lore, read intentions or persuade.
cards.lore: Steady hands and a calm voice, honed over a thousand sickbeds.

cards.name: Barkeep
cards.text: +2 on checks to read intentions, gather rumors, intimidate or lift.
cards.lore: Years behind the bar teach a lot: who lies, who drinks, who will start the fight.

cards.name: Smith
cards.text: +2 on checks to lift, break, haggle or recall lore.
cards.lore: The forge's wisdom: the weight of iron, the price of iron, where iron breaks.

cards.name: Mountaineer
cards.text: +2 on checks to climb, endure, navigate or balance.
cards.lore: Thin air and sheer cliffs were a home to them. The mountain never won.

cards.name: Twin Strike
cards.text: Once per turn, when you take the Attack action, make one extra attack.
cards.lore: A blade master's rhythm: a feint and a cut, so fast they sound like one blow.

cards.name: Second Wind
cards.text: Action (1/S.R.): regain 1d10 + 3 HP.
cards.lore: When others lie down, this one gets back up. Pain is a problem for later.

cards.name: Wiry
cards.lore: Lean, ropy strength. There was never much meat on them, but they never tired.

cards.name: Night Eyes
cards.lore: Eyes from something that lived in the dark. Shadows turn to shapes, then to detail.

cards.name: Sellsword
cards.text: +3 on checks to intimidate, endure, haggle or gather rumors.
cards.lore: Hard years selling a blade to whoever paid. You learn the price of everything, and of everyone.

cards.name: Acrobat
cards.text: +3 on checks to tumble, balance, jump or perform.
cards.lore: From a traveling troupe: flips, falls and a crowd that gasped every night.

cards.name: Slippery
cards.text: Reaction (2/S.R.): move up to half your Speed. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.
cards.lore: A knack for being somewhere else when the blow arrives.

cards.name: Hedge Witch
cards.text: 1 extra spell point (long rest). +3 on checks to handle animals, recall lore, treat wounds or deceive.
cards.lore: Herb lore and old charms from a cottage at the edge of the woods.

cards.name: Sweeping Blow
cards.text: 1/S.R., when you take the Attack action with a Heavy or Reach weapon: make one attack roll against each enemy within your reach instead. Half damage on a miss.
cards.lore: The wide arc of a giant's swing. Everyone in reach learns to fear it.

cards.name: Relentless
cards.text: 1/S.R., when damage drops you to 0 HP without killing you outright: you drop to 1 HP instead.
cards.lore: Something that would not stay down. Death had to ask twice, and it never asked again.

cards.name: Pack Hunter
cards.text: 1/S.R., when you hit a creature one of your allies is engaged with: it falls Prone.
cards.lore: Taken from a wolf. It knows the moment a friend has the prey, and when to pull it down.

cards.name: Human Grit
cards.text: Stubborn (1/S.R.): when you fail a check, add +2 to that roll, possibly turning it into a success.
cards.lore: Short-lived, stubborn and everywhere. Whatever they lack, they make up for by trying again.

cards.name: Elven Blood
cards.lore: Long years in a slender frame, and eyes that never quite lost the starlight.

cards.name: Dwarven Blood
cards.text: +2 STR Defense against poison, Shoves and Grapples.
cards.lore: Stone-born and slow to fall. Their blood shrugs off what would fell a lesser body.

cards.name: Halfling Luck
cards.text: Lucky (1/S.R.): when you roll a 1 on a d20, reroll it.
cards.lore: Small, cheerful and impossibly lucky. Fate seems to like them, and nobody knows why.

cards.name: Orcish Blood
cards.text: +2 on checks to intimidate, endure, lift or march.
cards.lore: Made for war and for the long march after it. The dark holds no secrets from those eyes.

cards.name: Hobgoblin Discipline
cards.text: +2 on checks to march, navigate, stand firm or read intentions.
cards.lore: Drilled from birth: a good soldier, a good scout, a good officer. Discipline is in the bones.

cards.name: Conjurer's Book
cards.text: Spell attack: INT + 2 Spell points: +2 (long rest) Max spell level: 2nd Casting needs an empty Hand.
cards.lore: Spells copied in a careful hand, the margins full of warnings. The ink still smells of ozone.

cards.name: Wanderer's Repertoire
cards.text: Attack: WIL + 2 Resolve: +3 (short rest) Songs, poems and dances.
cards.lore: Songs gathered at roadside fires and in tavern corners, sung by someone who never stayed long.

cards.name: Acolyte's Litany
cards.text: Attack: WIL + 2 Resolve: +3 (short rest) Prayers. Fate dice: d4.
cards.lore: Prayers learned by heart in a quiet temple. The faith came with them.

cards.name: Wildheart's Remembrance
cards.text: Resolve: +3 (short rest) Beasts your body remembers. Shift: action.
cards.lore: The memory of fur, feather and claw. The body knows these shapes, and longs for them.

cards.name: Twisted Ankle
cards.text: You hobble.

cards.name: Bruised Ribs
cards.text: Every breath hurts.

cards.name: Pulled Muscle
cards.text: You can't twist away in time.

cards.name: Concussion
cards.text: The world swims a little.

cards.name: Shaken
cards.text: You flinch at every shadow.

cards.name: Deep Cut
cards.text: Stitched, not healed.

cards.name: Black Eye
cards.text: −2 on ranged attacks and on checks to notice.

cards.name: Broken Nose
cards.text: −2 on WIL checks.

cards.name: Torn Tendon
cards.text: −2 on checks to climb, jump or swim.

cards.name: Weak Grip
cards.text: −2 on melee attacks.

cards.name: Cracked Jaw
cards.text: 1 less Resolve and 1 less spell point.

cards.name: Nightmares
cards.text: A short rest heals only a quarter of your missing HP (rounded up).

cards.name: Broken Arm
cards.text: Blocks one of your Hand Slots until it heals.

cards.name: Broken Fingers
cards.text: Blocks one of your Hand Slots until it heals.

cards.name: Swollen Hand
cards.text: Blocks one of your Jewelry Slots until it heals.

cards.name: Cracked Ribs
cards.text: Blocks one of your Item Slots until it heals.

cards.name: Wrenched Back
cards.text: Blocks one of your Item Slots until it heals.

cards.name: Shattered Knee
cards.text: You may never run the same again.

cards.name: Skull Fracture
cards.text: −2 on INT checks.

cards.name: Internal Bleeding
cards.text: You lose blood every time you move too fast.

powers.name: Fire Bolt
powers.text: Action, range 120 ft. Spell attack against DEX Defense: 1d10 Fire. A flammable object it hits catches fire.

powers.name: Mage Hand
powers.text: Action, range 30 ft, Duration 1 minute. A spectral hand lifts, carries or works an object up to 10 lb. It can't attack. Move it with your reaction.

powers.name: Magic Missile
powers.text: Action, range 120 ft. Three darts at one to three creatures. One spell attack against the DEX Defense of each target: 1d4 + 1 Radiant per dart on a hit, half on a miss. Upcast: +1 dart per level above 1st.

powers.name: Shield
powers.text: Reaction, when an attack hits you. +5 to your STR and DEX Defense until the start of your next turn, against the triggering attack too.

powers.name: Grease
powers.text: Action, range 60 ft, Duration 1 minute. A 10-ft cube of slick grease: difficult terrain. Spell attack against the DEX Defense of each creature in it, and of each one that enters it or ends its turn there: on a hit, it falls Prone.

powers.name: Misty Step
powers.text: Reaction. Teleport up to 30 ft to an unoccupied space you can see.

powers.name: Web
powers.text: Action, range 60 ft, Duration 1 hour. A 20-ft cube of webs: difficult terrain. Spell attack against the DEX Defense of each creature in it, and of each one that enters it: on a hit, it is Restrained for 2 turns. Fire burns a 5-ft square away each round.

powers.name: Jeer
powers.text: Action. Attack against WIL Defense: until the end of the target's next turn, it has −2 on its next attack.

powers.name: Rally
powers.text: Action, Duration 1 minute. Up to 3 allies within 30 ft have +2 on attacks.

powers.name: Hold the Line
powers.text: Action, Duration 1 minute. Allies within 30 ft have +2 to STR and DEX Defense.

powers.name: Cutting Words
powers.text: Reaction, after a creature within 60 ft rolls. −2 to an enemy's attack roll or check.

powers.name: Steady Now
powers.text: Reaction, after a creature within 60 ft rolls. +2 to an ally's roll, or to the Defense an attack targets.

powers.name: Dread
powers.text: Action. Attack against WIL Defense: the target is Frightened of you for 2 turns.

powers.name: Rousing Verse
powers.text: Action, range 60 ft. A creature regains 2d4 + WIL HP.

powers.name: Guidance
powers.text: Reaction, after an ally within 60 ft rolls a check. Add 1d4 to it.

powers.name: Bless
powers.text: Action, Duration 1 minute. Up to 3 allies within 30 ft add 1d4 to their attack rolls.

powers.name: Bane
powers.text: Action, Duration 1 minute. Attack against WIL Defense: the target subtracts 1d4 from its attack rolls.

powers.name: Twist Fate
powers.text: Reaction, after a creature within 60 ft rolls. Reroll: make it reroll an attack roll or a check.

powers.name: Healing Word
powers.text: Action, range 60 ft. A creature regains 2d4 + WIL HP.

powers.name: Cure Wounds
powers.text: Action, touch. A creature regains 2d8 + WIL HP.

powers.name: Hawk
powers.text: Tiny · Fly 60 ft. Talons: +2 to hit, 1d4 + DEX Physical. +2 on checks to notice.

powers.name: Wolf
powers.text: Medium. Bite: +2 to hit, 1d6 + DEX Physical. +2 on checks to track.

powers.name: Mossbalm
powers.text: Action, touch. A creature regains 2d8 + WIL HP.

powers.name: Bear
powers.text: Large · Climb 30 ft. Hide: +2 STR Defense (included). Claws: +2 to hit, 1d8 + STR Physical.

foes.name: Wolf
foes.own: Bite: +4 to hit, 1d6 + 2 Physical. Keen Nose: alert (passive Awareness +5).

foes.name: Legionary
foes.carries: Pilum (W-II-02); Gladius (W-I-14); Shield Wall (Q-I-06); Mail (A-I-02); Shield (S-I-01)
foes.own: Throws its Pilum, then draws its Gladius.

foes.name: Bandit Captain
foes.carries: Finesse Blade (W-I-04); Dagger (W-I-01); Twin Strike (Q-II-01); Leather (A-I-01); Coin Pouch (U-I-01)

foes.name: Ogre
foes.own: Giant Strength: +60 HP. Its Javelins roll one extra damage die (included). Its Sweeping Blow recharges on a 5–6 instead of 1/S.R.

foes.name: Ogre Chieftain
foes.carries: Greatclub (W-I-13); Cleave (Q-I-01); Second Wind (T-II-01); Sweeping Blow (Q-II-02); Plate (A-II-01)
foes.own: Warlord: its Sweeping Blow recharges on a 5–6 instead of 1/S.R. Bellow (Recharge 5–6): reaction. Attack (+5) against the WIL Defense of each enemy within 30 ft: Frightened of the chieftain until the end of its next turn.

foes.name: Guard
foes.carries: Longsword (W-I-05); Shield (S-I-01); Javelins (W-I-11); Mail (A-I-02); Human Grit (T-I-05)

foes.name: Scout
foes.carries: Longbow (W-I-09); Shortsword (W-I-02); Hunter (K-I-05); Leather (A-I-01); Elven Blood (T-I-06)

foes.name: Orc
foes.carries: Greataxe (W-I-16); Javelins (W-I-11); Relentless (T-II-07); Leather (A-I-01); Orcish Blood (K-I-10)

foes.name: Hobgoblin
foes.carries: Longsword (W-I-05); Shield (S-I-01); Longbow (W-I-09); Mail (A-I-02); Battle Hymn (Q-I-04); Hobgoblin Discipline (K-I-11)

foes.name: Skeleton
foes.own: Undead: resists Poison and Necrotic, vulnerable to Radiant. Never checks Morale.

foes.name: Zombie
foes.own: Undead: resists Poison and Necrotic, vulnerable to Radiant. Never checks Morale. Slam: +3 to hit, 1d8 + 1 Physical.

foes.name: Giant Rat
foes.own: Bite: +4 to hit, 1d4 + 2 Physical. Keen Nose: alert (passive Awareness +5).

foes.name: Giant Spider
foes.own: Spider Climb: climbs walls and ceilings at full Speed. Web Sense: alert (passive Awareness +5). Bite: +5 to hit, 1d8 + 3 Physical plus 1d8 Poison. Web (Recharge 5–6): action, range 30 ft. Attack (+3) against DEX Defense: Restrained for 2 turns.

foes.name: Troll
foes.own: Claws: +6 to hit, 2d6 + 4 Physical. Regeneration: regains 10 HP at the start of its turn, unless it took Fire or Poison damage since its last turn. Keen Nose: alert (passive Awareness +5). Thick Hide: +1 STR Defense (included).
